subject: Novabank procurement: vendor onboarding & PO timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Grant <lydia.grant@novabank.com>, Tom Reese <tom.reese@novabank.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Novabank procurement: vendor onboarding & PO timeline

Hi Lydia / Tom 	6

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the procurement path moving:

What we covered:
- Overview of Redwood Hosted inference offering and key SLAs (attached SLA proposal)
- Primary decision criteria: latency SLAs, logging/audit capabilities, and billing/PO flow
- High-level stakeholder map (procurement, security, legal, finance)

Action items / asks from your side:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and final PO approver at NovaBank (name & email).
2) Who owns the security/compliance questionnaire (SOC 2, encryption, data retention)? We’ll loop in our security lead directly.
3) Procurement path & timeline: estimated date you can issue a PO, any required vendor forms, and preferred billing contact.

Attachments I’m including: Redwood_SLA_Proposal_v2.pdf (summary of uptime/latency guarantees).

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- Ethan Park (cc’d) will be the security contact for technical questionnaire and evidence (SOC 2).
- I’ll send our standard vendor onboarding packet and a draft DocuSign for signature once we confirm billing details.
- If NovaBank can aim to issue a PO by ~June 22, we can target onboarding completion by early July.

Would love a quick reply with the stakeholder names and the expected PO timeline. Happy to jump on a 15-min follow-up if that helps.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Marissa / Lydia —

Appreciate the updates. A couple of quick security clarifications before we finalize:
1) Data residency: does Redwood support keeping logs and PII in US-only regions? We need to confirm where customer logs and KV caches are stored.
2) Evidence: can you provide a copy of your SOC 2 Type II (redacted OK) and a point of contact for any penetration test summaries?
3) Encryption & key management: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or only Redwood-managed keys?

Also attaching a PO intent document — Novabank expects to route a formal PO next week but wanted to signal intent: Novabank_PO_20270618.pdf

If those security items are satisfied, legal is likely to accept standard PO language.

Thanks,
Tom Reese
Head of Information Security | NovaBank
tom.reese@novabank.com | (206) 555-1199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reese <tom.reese@novabank.com>, Lydia Grant <lydia.grant@novabank.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novabank procurement: vendor onboarding & PO timeline

Tom / Lydia —

Thanks for the questions and the PO intent. Summary answers below and next steps to keep us on the 6/22 PO path: 

1) Data residency: Redwood Hosted supports region-specific deployments; for NovaBank we can ensure logs and any persisted KV caches remain in US regions only. We’ll document the region in the onboarding form.

2) SOC 2 & pentest: Attached is a link to our redacted SOC 2 Type II and a summary of our most recent pentest. Ethan (cc) is the security contact for follow-ups.
   - SOC 2 (redacted): https://vault.redwood.com/soc2/redwood_soc2_2027_redacted.pdf
   - Pentest summary: https://vault.redwood.com/pentest/summary_2027.pdf

3) Encryption & KMS: We support both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys via KMS integrations. If NovaBank requires CMK/HSM, we can enable that as part of onboarding (may add a configuration step).

Billing / PO routing: please send the PO to billing@redwood.com and cc marissa.cole@redwood.com. Once we receive the PO, finance will generate an invoice and we’ll schedule the onboarding kickoff.

Next steps (proposed):
- You (Lydia) return the completed onboarding form (filled) by EOD 6/18 — received, thank you.
- NovaBank issues PO by 6/22 and emails it to billing@redwood.com.
- Redwood sends DocuSign for MSA (or countersigns redlines) and provides SOC2/pentest artifacts to Tom.
- Onboarding kickoff targeted week of 6/28.

If that timeline still looks good, I’ll have Mateo schedule the kickoff and Ethan prepare the security packet.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
